verdict.rationale: Judging how fast a project ships patches from its public release history is a fair question for an open-source project like Ollama, so the axis applies. The pack has no evidence of release cadence, security advisories, CVE response times or patch turnaround. The only mentions are that deprecations are announced in release notes and a passing reference to version 0.1.27, and neither speaks to how quickly critical bugs or vulnerabilities get fixed.

support.subject: As a developer, I know how quickly the project ships patches for critical bugs and security vulnerabilities based on its public release history
